desc: The quiz party played solo in full (TTYD_PARTY_GAME_TEST=quiz on a finished file in Rogueport): player 1 joins with A, Start begins it, each of the ten questions answered with A a second in (no Start to skip the reveal), the result logged (each player's points; a solo player tops the screen's list, but no one was beaten: no Quiz Whiz, which a solo quiz once gave even with 0 points), B closes it; then control back, no menu, the file as before (TTYD_MODERUN's party runs, moderun_party_aurora.c: "[moderun] Quiz ..."); the run ends when the mode does
log_must: \[quiz\] result: 1 player, P1 \d+; solo: no one to beat$
\[moderun\] Quiz over after \d+ frames: player 1 wins, \d+ points
\[moderun\] control back after Quiz: \d+ frames, no menu
\[moderun\] check after Quiz: stats same, partners same, badges same, items same, key items same, coins (\d+) -> \1, .*story same
